opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research infrastructure, with occasional support for access/research libraries and public engagement with science. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

next_open_date.raw: We expect to share the dates and details of our next funding round in spring 2027

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: High-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK; at least two years of exam results; Good rating from Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new build, refurbishment and technical equipment to improve GCSE and A-Level teaching of science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music and performing arts. 2026 round closed; decisions November 2026.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority providing special educational needs education at secondary level; Good regulator rating (CQC/Ofsted) if applicable; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment supporting pupils at secondary level to develop employment and independent living skills. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or hospice operating within the NHS; Good regulator rating if applicable; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for places providing excellent care to patients and families. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority working with disability; Good regulator rating if applicable; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to help people with disabilities live more independently, with interest in training, employment and supported housing, especially transitions from children's to adults' services. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority working in mental health; Good regulator rating if applicable; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for projects in mental health, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority providing care/services for older people (particularly neurodegenerative conditions or isolation); Good CQC rating if applicable; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for services for older people. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open to the public; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for conservation/restoration, interpretation and education spaces at historic sites, landscapes, and places of worship of other faiths (cathedrals can apply). Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority operating fully accredited libraries/archives caring for nationally significant collections, open to the public; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives with nationally significant collections. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority operating fully accredited museums/galleries holding permanent collections of national significance; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally refurbishing/creating galleries. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity or local authority focused on professional performance, with significant education work; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for building/refurbishing training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, and occasionally specialist equipment. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered/exempt charity, local authority or university displaying scientific/natural history collections of national significance; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for refurbishing/creating galleries and education spaces to improve public engagement with science through the history of science. Two-stage application process.
